blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Conflicting accounts have emerged following the fatal shooting of two men in Barangay Bataan, San Juan, Batangas on Nov. 17, as authorities identified the victims as communist insurgents while their families and supporters maintain they were civilians unjustly killed. Killed were Gilbert Orr, a known community organizer working with farmers, and Jayson Cortas, a local tricycle driver. The shooting occurred around 9 p.m. during an operation involving elements of the Armed Forces of the Philippines, Philippine National Police, and the Regional Mobile Force Battalion. Col.
